brand_identity.name: SILVERSY®
brand_identity.aesthetic_tone: MODERN, EDITORIAL, MINIMAL, LUXURY, FASHION, SILVER, CINEMATIC, SOFT, PREMIUM
brand_identity.emotional_goal: Tactile intimacy, modern heirloom elegance, quiet luxury silver sheen against serene warm alabaster and cream environments.

rules: NO dark or black backgrounds for main sections — maintain light luxury warmth
Silver jewellery elements must radiate with subtle polished sheen over warm neutral backgrounds
Avoid heavy gold tones; retain strict focus on 92.5 pure silver finish
All card containers with borders must include internal padding (p-6 to p-8) to avoid text collision

scale.giant_hero_masthead: text-[14vw] sm:text-[15vw] lg:text-[16vw] font-serif uppercase tracking-tight leading-none
scale.h1_section_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-none text-[#202020]
scale.h2_subtitle: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif italic text-[#383838]
scale.micro_label: text-[10px] sm:text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] font-sans font-medium text-[#75726D]

rules: Headings MUST use Editorial Serif for identity and impact
Subtitles & category tags use wide letter-spacing tracking-[0.25em]
Typography sometimes intentionally overlaps or extends beyond containers in hero and editorial callouts

hero_3d_r3f_specifications.scope: ONLY Hero 3D media replacement. Retain all site typography, layout, cream palette, and navigation morph timing.

mesh_anatomy.model_type: Skinned articulated white mannequin hand mesh (.gltf / .glb)
mesh_anatomy.aesthetic: Visually plausible human hand anatomy with smooth matte porcelain finish, realistic bone structure, fingers, palm, and wrist (NOT primitive capsules or robotic blocks)

index_finger_ring.placement: Attached directly to Index Finger Proximal/Intermediate Phalanx bone
index_finger_ring.gemstone: Large rectangular emerald-cut brilliant stone centered on top
index_finger_ring.prongs: Four corner silver prongs holding the emerald cut stone

materials.gemstone: meshPhysicalMaterial (transmission: 0.98, thickness: 0.8, roughness: 0.01, ior: 2.417, dispersion: 0.04, color: #ffffff)

ring_finger_ring.placement: Attached directly to Ring Finger Proximal Phalanx bone
ring_finger_ring.gemstone: Small round solitaire brilliant diamond stone

wrist_bracelet.type: Single-row tennis bracelet with continuous stone-set prongs

lighting_and_hd_reflections.environment: <Environment> studio setup using Lightformers for dynamic silver and gemstone reflections
lights: Directional main light at [4, 6, 5] with intensity 1.2
Fill light at [-4, 2, -2] with warm white hue intensity 0.5
Top soft key Lightformer with scale [10, 10, 1] intensity 3.0
Rim light Lightformer for crisp silver edge highlights
lighting_and_hd_reflections.tone_mapping: ACESFilmicToneMapping or neutral tone mapping with exposure 1.1 for HD crystal clarity without clipping

bone_rotations.open_hand: Progress 0.0 — fingers extended outwards gracefully showing top faces of rings and tennis bracelet
bone_rotations.closed_hand: Progress 1.0 — smooth fist curl/closing transition as user scrolls down
bone_rotations.interpolation: slerp bone rotations smoothly inside useFrame using scroll progress ref target

occlusion_and_layering.rule: REMOVE mix-blend-multiply on hero hand container. Render 3D hand with opaque background matching canvas background (#F5F1EA / alpha: true with canvas overlay) so the giant masthead text ('SILVERSY') sits behind the 3D hand and is naturally occluded by the physical hand model.

fallbacks.mobile_and_reduced_motion: For prefers-reduced-motion or WebGL low-spec devices, render a pre-rendered HD frame image while retaining interactive layout and CTA.

sections_breakdown.title: MORE THAN JEWELLERY.
sections_breakdown.layout: Editorial 2-column split with large lifestyle photography and smooth scroll parallax
sections_breakdown.content: At Silversy, jewellery is more than an accessory. It is a reflection of identity, expression and the moments we choose to remember.

sections_breakdown.title: CRAFTED IN 925
sections_breakdown.layout: Metallic highlight feature with huge reflective 925 typography and 3 core pillars: PURITY, CRAFT, TIMELESS DESIGN
sections_breakdown.content: 92.5 STERLING SILVER — High polish purity, hand-finished perfection.

sections_breakdown.title: EXPLORE THE COLLECTION
sections_breakdown.layout: Asymmetric bento grid on desktop with hover image zoom, subtle silver reflection & smooth arrow transition; horizontal scroll on mobile.

sections_breakdown.title: SIGNATURE PIECES
sections_breakdown.layout: 6–8 curated product cards with category, title, price badge ('PRICE ON REQUEST' or item price), and 'VIEW PIECE →' trigger opening modal.
sections_breakdown.card_style: Sharp rectangular borders (border-[#E5DFD5]), subtle image zoom, light cream surface, no heavy shadows

sections_breakdown.title: LOOK CLOSER. DETAILS MATTER.
sections_breakdown.layout: Cinematic single large silver piece feature with interactive 360-degree rotation view, zoom toggle, and interactive detail hotspots (925 SILVER, SIGNATURE FORM, CRAFTED DETAIL).

sections_breakdown.title: THE ART OF DETAIL
sections_breakdown.layout: Editorial split with macro silver detail shot and key philosophy quote
sections_breakdown.content: Every piece should balance presence and simplicity — jewellery designed to complement the person wearing it.

sections_breakdown.title: MOST LOVED CREATIONS
sections_breakdown.layout: 4-column editorial grid (2-column on mobile) featuring popular items with quick enquiry trigger.

sections_breakdown.title: THE SILVERSY WORLD
sections_breakdown.layout: Editorial masonry lifestyle gallery with subtle hover overlay and direct Instagram link.

sections_breakdown.title: FIND YOUR SIGNATURE PIECE.
sections_breakdown.subtitle: Discover the world of 92.5 sterling silver jewellery.

sections_breakdown.layout: Minimal luxury footer with large oversized SILVERSY® logo watermark, category columns, store info, and social links.

motion_and_microinteractions.lenis_smooth_scroll: Enable smooth momentum scrolling globally for cinematic feel
motion_and_microinteractions.metallic_reflections: Subtle Three.js or CSS linear shimmer reflecting light over '925' and signature headings
motion_and_microinteractions.hover_effects: Image zoom transform scale-105, border color transition to #C0C0C0, text arrow translate-x-1

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_policy: All key interactive buttons, modals, category links, product cards, WhatsApp/Instagram CTAs MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-explore-btn', data-testid='product-card-1', data-testid='hero-3d-canvas', data-testid='whatsapp-enquire-btn').
testing_and_accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap non-essential scroll animations with prefers-reduced-motion check or simple CSS fallback
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_check: All text elements exceed 4.5:1 APCA contrast ratio against warm background #F5F1EA / #FAF9F6

instructions_to_main_agent.toasts: Use Sonner toast notifications (located in src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or similar) for enquiry confirmation
instructions_to_main_agent.modal_feature: Product click MUST trigger an elegant detail modal showcasing product imagery, 92.5 hallmark details, 'ENQUIRE ON WHATSAPP' button (pre-filled text), and 'VIEW ON INSTAGRAM' button
instructions_to_main_agent.header_morph: Ensure sticky navigation stays clean with high z-index and semi-opaque background backdrop-blur-md bg-[#FAF9F6]/85
